terms.gloss: not a poster: a title or heading
terms.comment: Classically the heading of a law or a pretext; for a notice put up in public Latin has prōscrīptiō or libellus.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 30, checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
